description: Run with debug_verify_statement set to bind_statement - planning each statement in the bind only and the full planning mode and comparing their signatures

skip_tests.reason: Extra binds log their warnings and contexts again

Binding a table function whose argument calls nextval advances the sequence once per planning: in autocommit the read-only planning transaction cannot commit that (BindStatement fails the same way, and Prepare also invalidates the database), and inside a transaction the sequence moves three times instead of once
Extra binds read the file's schema again, which the I/O metrics count
The verification binds before the statement's deadline starts, so it does not interrupt an expansion that only the deadline bounds
